ceo_commentary: Lip-Bu Tan: 'AI is driving unprecedented demand for compute... our Q2 results represent our strongest revenue growth in more than fifteen years, enabled by greater speed, accountability, and customer focus.' Also: 7th consecutive quarter beating guidance; AI-driven businesses grew >70% YoY (~70% of revenue); supply constraints (wafers, memory, substrates) remain dominant challenge; PC consumption subseasonal H2, down low-double-digits for full 2026.
narrative_angle: Intel just delivered its best quarter in 15 years — 25% revenue growth, a 92% EPS beat, 18A yields and output ahead of plan, and a >$20B capex commitment — and the stock STILL fell 29% in July, including 8% the day after earnings. The GAAP print shows a $11B loss (driven by a $12.5B non-cash mark-to-market on the US government's escrowed CHIPS Act shares — the price of being America's national champion). With the US government holding a ~10% stake, DCAI up 59%, and 14A already outpacing 18A's trajectory, the question is whether the July selloff is a gift or a warning. Stock rebounded ~10% off the July 31 low to ~$99 by Aug 7.
key_catalysts: Q3 guidance above consensus: $15.8-16.8B revenue (avg est $16.4B), $0.38 non-GAAP EPS vs $0.39 est; 7th straight quarter of beating guidance
DCAI up 59% YoY to $6.3B — AI compute demand ('unprecedented' per CEO) with AI-driven businesses ~70% of revenue
Intel Foundry external revenue $293M with 18A output >50% QoQ and yields ahead of plan; Panther Lake in HVM on 18A with High NA EUV
14A commitment: PDK 0.9 due October, risk production 2H 2027, HVM 2028 — defect density outpacing 18A's early trajectory
CapEx raised to >$20B for 2026 (2027 significantly higher) — demand-signal conviction from customers
$29.7B cash + STI, $7.0B Q2 operating cash flow, +$4.45B Q2 free cash flow — self-funding the buildout
US government ~10% non-voting stake (433.3M shares @ $20.47) — strategic backstop, but escrowed-share MTM creates GAAP noise
July selloff of -29% (and -35% from 52w high) vs analyst mean target $115.17 (16% upside) and high target $200
Next earnings Oct 22, 2026 (est $0.39 EPS) — Q3 QTD 18A yields already trending ahead of March targets
ASIC/custom silicon at ~$2B run rate targeting ~$4B; 18A-P risk production started
